details.description: Mistral NeMo Base 2407 is a 12-billion-parameter pretrained (non-instruct) language model that Mistral AI built jointly with NVIDIA and released in July 2024. Mistral AI describes it as a drop-in replacement for Mistral 7B, trained with a 128,000-token context window and a large proportion of multilingual and code data. As a base checkpoint it has no instruction-tuning and, per its model card, 'does not have any moderation mechanisms', so it is meant as a foundation for further fine-tuning rather than direct chat use. Mistral AI's own model-status page lists the Mistral NeMo 12B family as deprecated (2026-05-22) and retired from its hosted API as of 2026-07-31, with Ministral 3 8B given as the replacement.
advantages: 128,000-token context window, positioned by Mistral AI as a drop-in replacement for Mistral 7B, per the model card.
Scores 68.0% on MMLU (5-shot) and 83.5% on HellaSwag (0-shot) in Mistral AI's own benchmark table.

Trained on a large proportion of multilingual and code data, with multilingual MMLU tested across French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese and Japanese (59.0-64.6%), per the model card.
Apache 2.0 licensed for commercial and open-source use.
disadvantages: Pretrained base model only; the model card states it 'does not have any moderation mechanisms' and is not instruction-tuned for chat.
Mistral AI's model-status page lists the Mistral NeMo 12B family as deprecated (2026-05-22) and retired from Mistral's own hosted API as of 2026-07-31, with Ministral 3 8B as the listed replacement.
use_cases: Base checkpoint for fine-tuning into instruction-following or domain-specific chat models.
Foundation used by Mistral AI to train Mistral-NeMo-Instruct-2407.

notes: Catalog's max_input/output_tokens (128000) match the model card's stated 128k context window, so no conflict. Mistral AI's model-status page places Mistral NeMo 12B's deprecation on 2026-05-22 and retirement on 2026-07-31, after which Ministral 3 8B is the listed replacement; the catalog's facts carry no deprecation_date for this entry. Named languages come from the card's multilingual-MMLU table, which may not be an exhaustive language list.
